content.short: Moonwell is a leading decentralized lending protocol on Base, Moonbeam, and Moonriver featuring cross-chain asset markets.
content.description: Moonwell is a premier open lending and borrowing protocol operating across the Base, Moonbeam, and Moonriver networks. Designed for maximum accessibility and security, the platform allows users to supply various digital assets—including ETH, USDC, and native ecosystem tokens—to earn interest or borrow against them in a transparent, non-custodial environment. Moonwell has seen significant growth on the Base network, integrating closely with Coinbase-supported assets like cbBTC and EURC to provide institutional-grade liquidity tools to retail participants. Governed by the WELL token, the protocol features a Safety Module where users can stake tokens to secure the network.
